reply.summary: Talone is a trader turned musket-carrying patriot who helps break a siege in a harbour town during a colonial uprising. Talone is repaid with a broad tract of land, and his descendants build a brooding mansion upon it.

feats.scene: Talone fires a volley that scatters a line of redcoated skirmishers.
Talone marches through sleet and grapeshot with a torn sleeve and little else.

reply.summary: Nialornas is a hired gun with a gift for smothering minds in a cloud of blackness, working for a firm of mercenary kidnappers. Nialornas loses control when a swarm of cloned teen minds floods his thoughts, freeing his captive.

feats.scene: Nialornas folds a hallway into pitch gloom and drops a guard where he stands.
Nialornas keeps his footing for a few seconds under a barrage of overlapping thoughts.

reply.summary: Rnile is a glamorous spy whose reputation rivals the most famous infiltrators of the last war. Rnile slips through embassies and ballrooms with forged papers and a cool smile, leaving rivals to guess her true name.

feats.scene: Rnile jabs a hatpin into a guard's wrist and slips out of the room.
Rnile climbs from a second-floor window and lands lightly on her feet.

reply.summary: Nesorti is a tall, pale-haired invader who dwells among drifting rocks, manipulates alien minds and breeds armies of warrior drones to wipe out whole peoples. Nesorti rebuilds himself after each defeat, clinging to starships and wrecking worlds until a crew finally destroys him.

feats.scene: Nesorti clamps onto a starship hull and squeezes until the armour begins to buckle.
Nesorti rides out a violent surge across the hull and releases only when forced.

reply.summary: Niutauor is a hooded cult figure who lurks in a rainy old capital, draping his schemes in robes and ritual. Niutauor keeps his true name hidden and speaks only through secret symbols and the fear they stir.

feats.scene: Niutauor hurls a pulse of shadow that cracks a stone altar.
Niutauor shakes off a thrown candlestick and does not break stride.

reply.summary: Ntrer is a blue-skinned, red-eyed tyrant who rules a crystalline plane where every citizen wields gem-based gifts. Ntrer hurls bolts of uncanny force, punches hard enough to injure a mighty youth, and hunts a young heir who opposes him.

feats.scene: Ntrer unleashes a bolt of violet force that blasts a crystal tower into gravel.
Ntrer shrugs off a flurry of blows from a powerful youth and strikes back.

reply.summary: Ulcesres is the feathered, grey-skinned dark half of a heroine, torn from her soul by a vengeful fiend and freed to act alone. Ulcesres bargains with a ruthless official for a cursed relic and crown, and spreads turmoil among masked heroes.

feats.scene: Ulcesres rips a skyscraper's facade away with a crimson surge of power.
Ulcesres is blasted through a wall by a team of heroes and rises smiling.

reply.summary: Iumeoneon is a malicious mirror copy of a young alien hero, conjured by a ray from her own troubled thoughts. Iumeoneon carries the original's boundless might and warped memories, and she wants only fun and freedom with the strength of a god.

feats.scene: Iumeoneon punches a canyon wall and splits the cliffside for a mile.
Iumeoneon walks unharmed out of an exploding suit's energy volley.

reply.summary: Artorll is a lone bird-themed guardian who patrols a scorched, far-future wasteland. Artorll glides through ruins at dusk and looks after survivors huddled in the rubble.

feats.scene: Artorll swoops down and kicks a raider off a ruined tower.
Artorll takes a fall onto cracked concrete and keeps moving.

reply.summary: Veonesar is a bodiless mass of pure malice that seeps into a team of heroes and turns them against their own world. Veonesar spreads like a contagion, feeds on feelings and deceives its hosts into ruin.

feats.scene: Veonesar drives a possessed team to flatten a skyline in a single night.
Veonesar slips through a storm of weapons fire as if it were mist.

reply.summary: Corsures is a grey-skinned, red-eyed deity of the ancient age who waged a legendary war against a rival sea power over the tides. Corsures rules by menace and imperial will, and the oceans remember his cruelty.

feats.scene: Corsures splits a vast sea trench with a blast and drains the water into the gap.
Corsures stands unharmed amid a thunderous clash of rival divine forces.

reply.summary: Rnnaias is a grey tyrant of a burning world who sends winged drones to plant portal cubes, hungering to rule all existence. Rnnaias outfights lone champions, loses both eyes to a united team, and dies at last in a ruinous final war.

feats.scene: Rnnaias blasts a fleet of drones' targets and fractures a whole mountain range.
Rnnaias takes the combined assault of a champion squad and keeps coming.
Rnnaias races across an ocean in a heartbeat to seize his prey.

reply.summary: Olucato is a grey despot who rules a fire-wracked world as part of a cabal of masterminds, struggling for supremacy with an immortal rival. Olucato fires rays that disintegrate matter, fathers three heirs and matches armies on his own.

feats.scene: Olucato fires a crimson beam that vaporises a fortified bluff.
Olucato stands unharmed through a barrage of heavy artillery.

reply.summary: Cisralvor is the undying master of a burning world whose reign stretches to the last days of time, and who even leads a lost people after their homeland falls. Cisralvor crushes a band of warrior women and finally dies in a duel inside a dying sun.

feats.scene: Cisralvor sweeps aside an island army and scorches its green hills to ash.
Cisralvor grapples a rival deep inside a collapsing star before succumbing.

reply.summary: Stsene is a grey, brick-bodied overlord of a smoking planet who commands underlings to capture rivals and seize a coveted cube. Stsene hurls rays, flies, bends minds, leaps, and shrugs off poisons, though his plans collapse when captives escape.

feats.scene: Stsene fires a ray from his eyes that demolishes a row of toy-like towers.
Stsene is smashed through a wall by a heroic fist and steps out unmarked.

reply.summary: Auiuniu is a hulking, red-eyed overlord of a fiery world, drawn in blocky plastic style as an invader with a booming voice. Auiuniu lifts armoured vehicles overhead and fires searing rays from his eyes.

feats.scene: Auiuniu fires a pair of beams that turns a toy city block to rubble.
Auiuniu stands unmoved as a stack of plastic bricks explodes over him.

reply.summary: Irnnutia is a pint-sized, grey-faced emperor of a scorched world who glowers at a caped detective and scolds a nervous underling. Irnnutia wields a searing glare from his eyes and a ferocious temper that erupts when his servant asks for better quarters.

feats.scene: Irnnutia flicks a ray from his eyes that blows a hole through a stone wall.
Irnnutia is knocked flat by a caped fist and brushes it off with a scowl.

reply.summary: Tirtilirn is a grey invader who spends weekdays working in a school kitchen and weekends plotting world takeover. Tirtilirn hurls a flaming rock at a planet and traps a rescue team on it with searing rays before leaving to make it to work on time.

feats.scene: Tirtilirn hurls a burning boulder toward a populated planet.
Tirtilirn takes a pummelling from small heroes and still reports for his shift.

reply.summary: Aminuse is a green-eyed war criminal from a wrecked postwar country who escapes judgment and delves into the occult. Aminuse wields a mystic sphere to raise armies of the dead and strike foes with uncanny bolts until a vengeful hunter and a revived twin end her.

feats.scene: Aminuse lifts a hundred corpses from a field and sends them marching on a village.
Aminuse is bruised by a hunter's strike and keeps hold of her sphere.

reply.summary: Naulaval is one of many lab-grown minions sent by a hidden overlord to hunt a pair of teenagers who borrow heroic forms by dialling. Naulaval fires bursts of energy of unclear origin and obeys without question.

feats.scene: Naulaval hurls a bolt of raw energy that sets a parked van alight.
Naulaval takes a heavy blow from a teen disguised as a hero and holds on.

reply.summary: Colorst is a primordial being from beneath the waves, the wellspring of a drowned civilisation's sorcery and a terror that makes the fears of wizards solid. Colorst is locked away by a wary monarch who dreads the entity's power to remake everything.

feats.scene: Colorst warps a flooded city into a nightmare of its citizens' deepest fears.
Colorst withstands a barrage of sorcery and reabsorbs every spell.

reply.summary: Aullu is a colossal armoured reptile that drifts in from deep space as an egg, devours every living thing on a world, and enslaves its mightiest survivors. Aullu is finally launched into space and punched back down so hard that he forms a new landmass.

feats.scene: Aullu swallows a whole continent's armies and unleashes a beam that scorches the coast.
Aullu shrugs off the mightiest attacks of a league of heroic reptiles.

reply.summary: Stitesi is a cheerful girl who, with five friends, merges into one mighty champion by shouting a magic word. Stitesi helps her merged self challenge a warrior queen in a doomed war, and dies when the world ends.

feats.scene: Stitesi and her friends combine and hurl a stone column across a battlefield.
Stitesi's merged form tanks a spear thrust before being forced apart.

reply.summary: Ntnoleo is a bright schoolgirl and natural sprinter who is gifted the swiftness of a messenger god in a timeless sanctum. Ntnoleo shouts with five friends to fuse into a lightning-flinging champion, and joins a desperate time-warped campaign.

feats.scene: Ntnoleo and her friends merge and drive a fist through a thick stone door.
Ntnoleo's merged form shrugs off a flurry of hits from a sorceress.
Ntnoleo streaks through a crowded street faster than any engine.

reply.summary: Toserst is a faceless make-believe companion, born in a lonely girl's mind, who returns bent on revenge after being cast aside. Toserst depends on her creator's thoughts to exist, and fades once her maker regains control.

feats.scene: Toserst bursts a wardrobe door and pins a sleeper to the floor.
Toserst absorbs a wild blow and remains in place.

reply.summary: Telsorori is a fair-haired staff officer in military spycraft who briefs a daring spy during a great war. Telsorori coordinates reports and orders from a cramped office, never seeing the front.

feats.scene: Telsorori slams a map-table drawer shut in anger.
Telsorori shakes off a stumble down a flight of stairs.

reply.summary: Renanora is a quick-witted scholar who briefly fights crime in a borrowed costume, using a band that stores kinetic force. Renanora later grows apart from her mentor and begins a quiet romance with a friend's former love.

feats.scene: Renanora releases the band's stored shock and knocks a mugger across an alley.
Renanora is clipped by a thrown bottle and the band cushions the blow.

reply.summary: Caliu is a married hero who shrinks to the size of a toy while keeping his full strength, and is swept through a swirling gate to a war-torn alternate world. Caliu fights tyranny for decades alongside patriot comrades before returning home to a world he hardly knows.

feats.scene: Caliu shrinks, darts across a table and slams a tiny fist into a spy's jaw.
Caliu rides out a shell burst while the size of a toy.

reply.summary: Selliu is a dark-haired fanatic who loathes anything odd and thinks himself a model of the ordinary, though he secretly wields bizarre devices himself. Selliu recruits a sham death squad, falls to the oddballs he hunted, and is humiliated by a living lane.

feats.scene: Selliu opens a humming crate and blasts a hallway with a wave of confusion.
Selliu gets thrown to the pavement and sits up demanding order.

reply.summary: Vosrnill is a pink-streaked botanist and aspiring vocalist who keeps his parents' expectations at arm's length. Vosrnill lives by strict nonviolence, avoids meat, and befriends a plant-loving outlaw when he finds a corpse in the greenhouse.

feats.scene: Vosrnill pushes open a stuck greenhouse door.
Vosrnill is shoved aside by a panicking crowd and stands back up.

reply.summary: Lloratau is a red-haired rampager in a violent gang who can form knives of pure mental force but prefers the noise of explosives. Lloratau is knocked out in one punch by a stronger hero during a rampage through farm country.

feats.scene: Lloratau detonates a cache of dynamite that wrecks a general store.
Lloratau tries to stand after a single punch and falls unconscious.

reply.summary: Saunantau is an orange-skinned, red-haired alien wanderer whose whole body was remade by cloning experiments. Saunantau now fires a limitless supply of quills from his skin and regrows them within hours, though he can still be wounded.

feats.scene: Saunantau fires a spray of quills from his shoulders that pin a thug's coat to a crate.
Saunantau takes a heavy fall and grits his teeth as his skin regrows its spines.

reply.summary: Toeoes is a century-old, brown-haired immortal woman from an elder race, equipped with a glowing band and years of experience. Toeoes fights three heroes who thwart her father's time-bending scheme, and burns her own hand touching his remains before swearing vengeance.

feats.scene: Toeoes projects a green construct that crushes an empty cargo ship.
Toeoes survives a scorching blast of emerald force and hurries away.

reply.summary: Inulluli is a swaggering researcher who tests an experimental machine on himself and becomes a hulking simian brute bent on proving his genius. Inulluli plots to steal a visiting spacecraft and trigger an interplanetary quarrel, only to be beaten by a stretchy hero.

feats.scene: Inulluli rips open the hatch of a flying saucer with his hairy fists.
Inulluli is thrown into a swamp tree and rises, snarling.

reply.summary: Llotaust is a green-eyed noblewoman in a hilltop fortress who moves objects by thought and transforms matter and living things into other forms. Llotaust turns soil into obedient golems, makes a jaguar into a monster that runs on air, and teleports a whole party at once.

feats.scene: Llotaust raises a troop of stone golems from a hillside and sends them to smash a gatehouse.
Llotaust takes a hard blast and teleports away before the next.

reply.summary: Tetiaser is a green-eyed robotic menace built for brute force, capable of soaring and blasts of power. Tetiaser charges a pair of atom-powered heroes of heroes and is destroyed after a short run.

feats.scene: Tetiaser fires an energy lance that bores through a tenement wall.
Tetiaser walks through a missile strike with only scorch marks.

reply.summary: Saamoto is a one-eyed gifted mind who runs his family's research firm while a virus slowly kills the whole clan. Saamoto breeds experimental subjects, arms himself with a beam pistol, and is killed aboard an orbital station by one of his own creations.

feats.scene: Saamoto fires a beam pistol that burns through a bulkhead door.
Saamoto stays on his feet through a violent shudder of the failing station.

reply.summary: Ernium is a scruffy pet canine adopted by an adolescent who wanted a small companion to call his own. Ernium chases balls, howls at the moon and loyally follows his owner around a cartoon town.

feats.scene: Ernium pounces on a squeaky toy and shakes it hard.
Ernium tumbles down a staircase and trots off wagging his tail.

reply.summary: Iumlor is a motorcycle-riding bloodsucker who turns a handful of young women into his brides and forces them to hunt for him. Iumlor is torn apart by bikes and staked, returns for revenge, and is again shot with a crossbow bolt and dismembered into five backpacks.

feats.scene: Iumlor hurls a former bride across a living room into a bookcase.
Iumlor is pulled by four engines in four directions and is still undead.

reply.summary: Lesca is a grey-haired ex-assassin from a secretive cabal who trains his daughter in lethal skills. Lesca moves with the cold precision of a practised killer and answers to no master.

feats.scene: Lesca drives a palm strike that folds a trained bodyguard.
Lesca shrugs off a baton to the ribs and counters at once.

reply.summary: Taante is a sullen teenager at a rough boarding school who is lumped in with his violent father's crimes. Taante resents the label, speaks to the guards with weary contempt and just wants to be left alone.

feats.scene: Taante shoves a bully into a locker with a flat palm.
Taante takes a punch in the dining hall and does not flinch.

reply.summary: Tenauno is a polite, worried lawman in a dusty desert town who keeps the peace when local boys vanish. Tenauno calms a mob of armed parents, jails outsiders for questioning and finally mounts a rescue at a collapsed cave.

feats.scene: Tenauno fires a warning shot that scatters an angry crowd.
Tenauno wades into a shoving mob and keeps his badge on.

reply.summary: Esraami is a fair-haired technician who co-owns a small scrap-recovery firm and runs its technical side. Esraami reverse-engineers fallen alien gadgets and turns the company from a scrapyard into a laboratory.

feats.scene: Esraami wrenches a seized bolt loose from a wrecked hull.
Esraami keeps working while sparks rain on his coat.

reply.summary: Iaseo is a smooth-voiced broadcaster who takes a spooky stage name from a drama to expose a careless builder after a collapse. Iaseo later fights beside a patriot team, teams up with an eccentric genius and his talking primate, and retires after the war.

feats.scene: Iaseo slugs a foreman and sends his hard hat spinning.
Iaseo takes a pipe across the back and keeps interrogating.

reply.summary: Vaslu is a late-night broadcaster who dons dark clothes and a mask after a tower collapses, crashing a rich host's party to collect donations for the victims. Vaslu carries a suction pistol on a silk cord and a screen that finds crimes.

feats.scene: Vaslu fires a suction cup that yanks a gunman off his feet.
Vaslu swings from a ledge and takes a hard landing on a balcony.

reply.summary: Selle is a blue-eyed chrono-voyager who rewrites the founding of a republic, defeats its troops and rules for centuries as a monarch. Selle is hunted down by a band of cartoon heroes who cross the centuries to undo his schemes.

feats.scene: Selle commands a time-skipping cannon that flattens a fort.
Selle withstands a charge by several heroes before his device is shut off.

reply.summary: Iarilvor is a mild researcher who flies into rage and swells into an indestructible overgrown infant. Iarilvor loses his wits while transformed, charges at a giant hare and is knocked out for his trouble.

feats.scene: Iarilvor swings a giant fist that caves in a brick wall.
Iarilvor shrugs off a battering volley of tank shells.

reply.summary: Silval is a gang boss posing as a graduate student who gains borrowed alien powers after a brain-cell transplant. Silval dons a lead-lined mask and goes on a crime spree, but his powers fade mid-fight and a hero must catch him.

feats.scene: Silval smashes a vault door off its frame with a single blow.
Silval takes a pounding from the rescuer and stays standing until his gift fades.

reply.summary: Auiumlu is a respectable business-club chairman who knows what every member can afford and exploits it. Auiumlu hides behind a gangster persona to run a shakedown ring until a clever sleuth breaks up his crew.

feats.scene: Auiumlu slaps a shopkeeper across the face to make him pay up.
Auiumlu is flung over a counter and rises to run.

reply.summary: Leocormi is a bereaved deckhand with a young son who survives a shipwreck only to share a cramped raft with two others. Leocormi dies so that scant supplies can keep a boy alive.

feats.scene: Leocormi hauls a heavy rope up the side of a lifeboat.
Leocormi endures cold waves and hunger for days on open water.
